title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Third edition, Volume 14, PAS-PLA - EB.6
text: This article had a place in former editions of our phumaspeasier under the idea of _by of tartar, or oli of tartor per deligium_, &C. It is, however, to be con-ified a a new water, foliation in the mid vegable ekiklit. formed by its scratching lineure from the air, and therefore it is with property flytled the _water of kali_.
